messages:
infra-bot: INCIDENT: multiple kubelet restarts detected in inference-usw2 pool (node-usw2-gpu-12). Auto-remediation tried: cordon+restart-kubelet. Error spike observed. Paging oncall.

hana: noticed P95 and 5xx jump for inference-usw2 ~12m ago. SD webhook triggered. Assigning P1 for now.

omar: I'm taking this. can someone share `kubectl get nodes` and pod list from inference namespace?

tess: dump at 3305551123:
```
$ kubectl get nodes
NAME               STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION
node-usw2-gpu-12   NotReady   gpu      42d   v1.24.9
node-usw2-gpu-04   Ready      gpu      15d   v1.24.9
node-usw2-gpu-07   Ready      gpu      9d    v1.24.9
```
```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep ml-worker
ml-worker-2   0/1 CrashLoopBackOff   node-usw2-gpu-12   0   2m
ml-worker-8   1/1 Running           node-usw2-gpu-07   0   6h
```

raj: logs from ml-worker-2 show repeated allocation failures:
```
E0410 08:21:11.012 ERROR runtime: CUDAMalloc failed: out of memory
E0410 08:21:11.013 ERROR serving: allocation failed while loading KV cache
F0410 08:21:11.014 CRITICAL aborting: uncaught std::bad_alloc
```

hana: kubelet system logs show kernel OOM + `nvidia: GPU reset required` followed by `kubelet: segfault` then process restart. Node restarted kubelet 3x in 5m.

omar: customer impact assessment: routing shows ~9-14% 5xx for the us-west inference routes last 10m. Tenants impacted: tenant-42 (high-traffic), tenant-88 (batch jobs), tenant-qa (dev). Opened support ticket for tenant-42.

tess: mitigation steps I'm executing now:
- cordon node-usw2-gpu-12 (infra-bot executed)
- start drain with `kubectl drain node-usw2-gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30`
- temporarily reduce per-pod concurrency: set env INFER_MAX_CONCURRENCY=1 for ml-worker deployment
- increase deployment replica count from 4 -> 6 in other nodes
- bump cluster autoscaler min nodes +2 in usw2-gpu ASG to allow more capacity
- enable routing fallback to cpu-quantized model for non-critical routes for 15m

hana: ops-bot: please run routing weight change to reduce traffic to inference-usw2 by 60%

ops-bot: executed: `redwood-routing update-weight --pool inference-usw2 --decrease 0.6 --reason kubelet-flap`

raj: drain started at 3305551138; one pod stuck on preStop hook for 20s then evicted. New pods scheduled to node-usw2-gpu-04 and -07.

omar: scaled replicas and changed concurrency at 3305551145. Autoscaler request accepted; new node request pending.

tess: post-action metrics at +4m: 5xx down to ~2.3%, P95 latency returning to baseline. tenant-42 still seeing intermittent errors for long-running batch inferences; support notified to rerun.

hana: root-cause hypothesis: combined effect of (a) KV-cache growth after recent patch to cache eviction in ml-runtime (rolled three days ago) and (b) transient GPU driver resets causing noisy neighbor memory pressure. We saw similar prologue in canary logs last week but not reproduced.

omar: immediate follow-ups assigned:
- raj: collect complete kubelet and dmesg logs from node-usw2-gpu-12 and upload to infra-s3 (ENG-482-logs).
- tess: revert concurrency change after stabilization and run canary stress with current runtime image.
- hana: update status page with customer note and slack #support ping.
- omar: open postmortem ENG-482, timeline + mitigation steps.

statusbot: status page updated: "Investigating - GPU node restart in US-West inference pool causing transient errors. Traffic partially shifted; mitigations in progress."

raj: uploaded logs to s3://infra-logs/eng-482/node-usw2-gpu-12/dmesg.log and kubelet.log (3305551168). dmesg shows repeated `oom_kill_process` on containerd-shim and `nvidia: GPU reset completed` messages clustered before kubelet restart.

omar: reducing severity from P1 -> P2 now that error rate is low and critical tenants are stable. Keeping thread open for postmortem.

tess: plan items for postmortem:
- memory profiling of kv-cache and add soft limit + eviction when resident set grows beyond threshold
- add node-level alert for >=2 `nvidia: GPU reset` events within 10m
- validate driver version pinned on GPU nodes and coordinate driver upgrade if needed
- evaluate making per-pod resource requests/limits stricter and adding pod anti-affinity for heavy GPU jobs
- ensure cluster autoscaler warm pool for GPU nodes to avoid cold-scaling delays

hana: handoff to oncall Omar for next shift. Omar, please monitor infra-logs bucket for any repeat and coordinate driver validation with infra-eng.

ops-bot: pagerduty: oncall changed from hana -> omar at 3305551188

omar: acknowledged. I'll take the 1hr watch and then hand to SRE. Closing active customer-impact flag; leaving thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
